review_scope: Read pinned source parameter export, source recipient code, parser, both scientific generator programs/specifications, native R evaluator, independent GLS implementation and controller reviews; two isolated entirely invented parameter fixtures executed separately.

checks.result: 28 demographic counts sum to 11509; 3 CSES, 10 education, 7 Gamma and 16 memory coefficients/SEs traced to pinned text; code specifies oldest bin 80-100 and visits0/2/4/6.

Cell-with-replacement sampling, uniform within-bin age, normal CSES, reference-coded multinomial education, Gamma shape1/phi and scale mu*phi, fixed16-term memory law, shared correlated subject intercept/slope and independent visit residual follow original rules.

Agent independently selected same reported recursive family; variance-column precision instead of squared rounded SD is explicitly recorded. No required alternative family or desired sign was injected by coordinator.

Finite age support and linear-normal CSES imply finite moments for the Gamma-log mixture and memory construction. No exponent of a positive quadratic Gaussian latent variable is introduced. This checks moments, not physiological tail accuracy.

Both unchanged programs passed isolated 12-subject,48-visit invented-law fixtures: identifier uniqueness, schedule, age transform, positive Gamma values and stable baseline fields. No HRS-configured output inspected.
All16 treatment-coded effects, two hinges centered6.5, age scaled by decade, subject intercept+slope, REML/bobyqa/maxfun2e8 match recipient source; one fit cap and warnings retained.
One baseline row per subject, sample SD n-1, subgroups <6.5 and >=6.5, categorical counts and percentages use appropriate denominators; all applicable HRS Table2 fields retained.

Separate Python design and per-subject covariance GLS recompute fixed effects and SE conditional on fitted variance; invented dense comparison and native bobyqa fixture reports passed. Does not certify variance optimum.
Paper HRS Original/Synthetic columns in Tables2/3 checked against PMC; complete source references admitted equally before freeze. Both columns are published source information.
Independent reviews repaired error-slot closure, binding and stale-file handling. Final six-slot/no-retry controller has code-review PASS and final byte hash.

limits: This is a source-rich recipient-stage reconstruction, not the full pooled ARIC/HRS/MICE experiment or new independent patient validation.
Original observed43500 visits differ from balanced46036 synthetic rows; printed parameters and current R runtime do not support bitwise historical reproduction.
Clinical final outcomes may be unfavorable; they are not reasons to adjust scientific candidates after release.
Three draws describe limited Monte Carlo behavior under fixed source parameters, not general clinical precision or a performance superiority claim.
